findings.issue: `chebyshevTBasis` and the follow-on lemmas `chebyshevTBasis_apply`, `span_T_Iio`, `span_range_T`, `mem_span_T_Iic`, `linearMap_eq_zero_of_forall_map_T_eq_zero`, `LinearMap.map_eq_zero_of_forall_map_T_eq_zero`, and `linearMap_ext_T` are all fixed to `ℝ`, although nothing in this algebraic file uses order, topology, or analysis.

summary: The new API is artificially specialized to `ℝ` even though the underlying Chebyshev and polynomial-sequence machinery is coefficient-generic. State the algebraic basis/span/extensionality results at the generic coefficient-ring level and derive the real use case from them.
